name: PlanCard
description: The current subscription plan: name, price and interval, status with the right text, renewal or end date, feature list, a usage hint, and the actions Change plan and Cancel subscription (confirmed, with the end date). A past due plan shows an alert. PlanPicker, exported beside it, lets people choose another plan. Your callbacks do the work. UI permission is not security: the server must check again.

plan.tsType: { name: string; price: number; interval: "month" | "year"; currency?: string; description?: string; features?: string[] }
plan.description: The plan: its name, the price per interval (in whole units, e.g. 49 for $49), an ISO currency code (default USD), an optional description and the features it includes.

status.description: Where the subscription stands. Each status has its own badge text and date line: active "Renews on", trialing "Trial ends on", past due "Payment failed", canceled "Ends on".

periodEnd.description: When the current period ends: the renewal date, the trial end or the end of access. An ISO date string or a Date.

usageHint.description: One line about use, e.g. "8 of 10 seats used". For a meter use UsageMeter beside the card.

locale.description: The locale for the price and the dates.

state.description: The data state: loading shows a skeleton, empty says there is no plan yet and offers Choose a plan, error shows a message with Try again.

onRetry.description: Adds a Try again button to the error state.

onChangePlan.description: Starts changing the plan; yours, async. Usually opens a PlanPicker.

onCancel.description: Cancels the subscription after the person confirmed in the dialog, which states the end date; yours, async.

onUpdatePayment.description: Adds an Update payment method button to the past due alert.

permissions.description: What the app allows: changePlan and cancel. Hidden renders nothing; disabled keeps the control reachable (aria-disabled) with the reason shown and read, and nothing runs. This only changes what people see: the server must check again.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: root, header, name, status, price, renewal, features, feature, usage, alert, actions, changeButton, cancelButton, updateButton.

keyboard: Tab: moves through Change plan and Cancel subscription
Cancel subscription opens a confirmation: Escape cancels, Enter confirms
requirements: The card is a group named by the plan name
The status is a badge with words (Active, Trial, Past due, Canceled), never only a color
A past due plan shows an alert that says what to do
The features are a list; each tick is decorative
The cancel confirmation states the date access ends
A disabled action stays focusable and the reason is its description
screenReader: "Cancel subscription, button"; the dialog says "You keep access until 3 March 2027"

use_when: Showing the plan a workspace is on with its renewal and the way to change or end it
A billing page next to UsageMeter and PaymentMethodCard
avoid_when: Comparing plans before choosing: use PlanPicker
anti_patterns: Treating the permissions prop as protection: UI permission is not security, so the server must check again
Cancelling from inside the component: onCancel is yours, and so is the end date it shows
Showing the status by color alone: the badge text carries it

contract.data: The current plan, its status and period end, and async callbacks for changing, cancelling and fixing payment.
